about: How Super Intelligence (SI) tools were used to make MOONKEEPER. NASA Space Apps asks that SI-made images and video carry a visible watermark, and that SI-made code and data say so in text and metadata. This file is that metadata; README.md says the same in words.
direction: A human designer chose what to build, asked for every change, and decided what went in.

code.checked_by: automatic tests in tools/*_test.mjs, and play-throughs in a browser

images.tool: Higgsfield image model (marketing-studio/image/sunburst), run by tools/gen_art.mjs
covers: assets/img/*.jpg and assets/img/mars/*.jpg (all 112 pictures: comic, characters, event cards, rooms, job games, title, endings, and the Mars buildings, places and crew)
images.watermark: Every picture from assets/img shows a visible 'SI-generated' mark in the game (js/simark.js, css/style.css, js/minigames.js). The interior textures are tiled across 3D walls and floors, so they cannot carry a mark of their own: while the player is inside the station, a label in the bottom-left corner of the screen says 'Station walls and floors: SI-generated' (js/simark.js, texMark).

video.tool: Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 (image-to-video and video-edit) for the demo video, Higgsfield Seedance 2.0 (image-to-video) for the home page film; Higgsfield image model for the Mars title card; planned and edited with Claude (Anthropic), assembled with FFmpeg
covers: demo/moonkeeper-demo.mp4 (30-second demo): the opening shot and the hopper shot use Seedance 2.5, the Mars title card and the end card use SI-made pictures; the other ten shots are recorded straight from the game

assets/video/title_loop.mp4 and title_loop_s.mp4 (the home page film): five seconds of the home page picture (assets/img/title3.jpg) with small movements, made with Higgsfield Seedance 2.0 image-to-video by tools/gen_film.mjs from tools/title_film.json; its first and last frame are the same picture, so it loops
video.watermark: A visible 'SI-generated' mark in the top right corner for the whole video; the same facts are in the file's metadata comment. The home page film plays inside the title background, which carries a visible 'SI-generated' mark (css/style.css).

translations.checked_by: node tools/i18n.mjs check (markup, key names and number places); not read by native speakers

not_si: assets/tex/earth.jpg and assets/tex/moon.jpg: NASA images (Blue Marble, CGI Moon Kit)
data/raw and js/nasa-events.js: NASA datasets (DONKI, Apollo seismic catalog, Meteorite Landings), processed by tools/build_data.mjs
REGO's voice: the speech built into the player's own device
The demo video's music: synthesised with FFmpeg from plain tones
